about: Bank SMS samples, one entry per message, collected bank by bank from the owner's phone. Each says what it is: inflow or outflow, the kind, and what Lightning should read from it. Identifying details are changed before a sample goes in: people's names, card and account endings, references, balances and neighbourhoods. Amounts, merchants and the exact wording stay. tests/test_sms_imports.py reads every entry; add a bank by adding its messages here. offers: adverts and bundles from the owner's inbox (2026-11-01, links replaced): never bank messages, never kept.
